description:
Connect Yandex Metrika to a site.

    IMPORTANT: authorisation happens IN A BROWSER, and neither you nor the
    platform can do that step for the user. The tool returns a link — show
    it and ask them to open it and grant access. Do not poll in a loop: the
    person may walk away for an hour. Check later through this same tool
    without the `branch` argument, or through `site_analytics`.

branch.description: The branch whose traffic is counted. Defaults to the production branch; pass it only when the user asks to track a preview branch.
branch.title: Branch

project.description: The project: its slug (`my-site`) or id, as listed by `my_projects`. The site address works too (`https://clear-garden-vypm.layero.app` or just `clear-garden-vypm`) — note that the address host is NOT always the slug.
project.title: Project
